exact_claim: Whether every positive transverse link in standard S3 attaining sl=-chi of a Seifert surface must be strongly quasipositive.
precise_gap: No construction of a maximal-Euler-characteristic disk-and-band surface retaining the given transverse link; topological braiding uses negative stabilization. Knot genus bounds do not imply existence of a minimal canonical surface.
novelty: No discovery claimed; credited standard reductions.
